character: Historic market town at valley floor. Gothic church, cobbled streets, Saturday market. Access to Grand Massif via gondola.
description: Samoens is one of the most beautiful market towns in the Alps — 15th-century Gothic church, cobbled market square, weekly Saturday market (one of the best in Haute-Savoie). The ski area is accessed via the Grand Massif gondola from the town. The valley floor altitude (700m) means the town itself has limited snow, but the ski area above (1,600m+) is reliable.

non_ski_activities.market_town: One of the most beautiful market towns in Haute-Savoie. 15th-century Gothic church (Notre-Dame de l'Assomption), central square with Gros Tilleul (ancient lime tree).
non_ski_activities.market: Saturday market — one of the best in Haute-Savoie. Local cheeses, charcuterie, crafts.
spas: Alexane Hotel & Spa — 1,000 m² wellness area, Montagnes du Monde spa, Himalayan salt scrubs, Alpine fir oil massages
Les Couadzous chalet wellness (hot tub, sauna, boot dryer)
O Fil de l'O and Ô des Cimes wellness temple — yoga, Pilates, sophrology, acupuncture, Ayurvedic massages
non_ski_activities.ice_swimming: Ice swimming at Lac aux Dames — hosted Ice Swimming World Championships. Mobile sauna available (Bastu74). From €75.
non_ski_activities.frozen_river_rafting: Nunayak — France's first winter river descent (rafting on frozen Giffre river). From €55/person.
non_ski_activities.pastry_classes: Ana De la Fuente — professional pastry chef (Hôtel de Crillon, Hôtel Lutetia). 3-hour classes, €40/person.
non_ski_activities.mountain_dining: Grand Massif Express area: Au Pré d'Oscar, 1600 café, Lou Caboens. Vercland gondola area: 45.8, Demoiselles des Saix, Chalet l'Aéro. La Luge à Téran (along Dahu blue run). Brasserie des Saix, Grand Crêt 17, Gers refuge.

honest_drawbacks: Valley floor altitude (700m) — no village snow
Requires shuttle/gondola to Grand Massif lifts
